check_details.detail: Plot is 40 ft N-S (12,192 mm) x 50 ft E-W (15,240 mm) with East arrival near NE corner.
Rear suites and G+1 rooms retained; kitchen and ICU enlarged using selected Plan A.
Wider south/east L-counter and retained short serving worktop; forecourt utility; no fridge or puja.
8 ft x 6 ft master bath (2438.4 x 1828.8 mm), lightwell enclosure (1500 x 1650 mm), and caregiver's internally accessed attached WC preserved.
3-flight staircase climbing South (2 risers) -> West (7 risers) -> North (9 risers) preserved.
Lower vehicle-parking porch set 152.4 mm (6.0 in, provisional adjustable setting) below raised house/veranda/forecourt/passages datum.
Plan A: rectangular Home ICU (201.1 sq ft) with East-facing recliner bed, shortened veranda return aligned with ICU west wall, and furnished drawing room.
Upper master, study, guest bedroom, baths, gallery and terrace fit the plot without overlaps.
First-floor slab leaves living/dining and the lightwell open.
18 approved risers plus two 179 mm arrival risers reach the 3508 mm first floor.
Second hall and open terrace fit the retained 40 × 50 ft plot without overlapping rooms.
Ground stair footprint copied exactly: 18 × 175 mm risers plus 2 × 179 mm arrival risers, 1100 mm wide, reaching +7016 mm.
1100 mm clear indoor east-edge bridge leads to the stacked South / West / North stair; enclosed top landing connects hall and terrace.
Second slab clears stair void. Analytic minimum above retained ground stair under new waist: 3153mm.
Lightwell remains open to sky through the second-floor slab.
